next.reason: 1985 VII.3.2.3 SR3: 'One or more record description entries must follow the file description entry' (only report files are exempt, XIII.3.2.3 SR4). 2023 brackets the record-description-entry group after file-description-entry in §2023:13.4.2, and §2023:13.4.5.3 SR3 lets a sequential FD have none when a RECORD clause is given (also §2023:13.18.43.3 SR1), WRITE/REWRITE name the FILE and FROM phrases and READ uses INTO. An FD without record descriptions, refused in 1985, is accepted: a compile-time relaxation, no exception condition.
